name: door_slam
brief: A heavy wooden interior door slammed shut, for a game. Dry and mono.

name: footsteps
brief: Four footsteps of a person walking at a normal pace on a wooden floor, shoes on.

name: pipe_drop
brief: A long steel pipe dropped onto a concrete floor, bouncing once or twice and ringing out.

name: brick_drop
brief: A brick dropped onto a stone path from waist height.

name: ui_confirm
brief: A short, friendly UI confirmation sound for a mobile game menu, under half a second.

name: campfire
brief: A small campfire crackling, a 4 second seamless loop.

name: splash
brief: A stone the size of a fist thrown into a pond: the splash and the bubbles after it.

name: door_knock
brief: Three firm knocks with knuckles on a wooden front door.

name: coin
brief: A single coin dropped onto a wooden table, bouncing and settling.

name: whoosh
brief: A fast whoosh of a sword swung through the air past the listener.
